ceres.note: Horizons SPK for 1 Ceres; for 2012-2067 Horizons answers with the Dawn flight-project trajectory solution rather than a fresh numerical integration of osculating elements.
ceres.representation: CSPICE sampling of the source SPK re-expressed as Chebyshev polynomials on 32-day windows, degree 19; not the original MDA record. The published bundle reproduces the source as CSPICE evaluates it, worst measured residual 0.000063 km inside a window.
